title: Grant Road Bridge, Spanning Broad Branch Creek on Grant Road, Washington, District of Columbia, DC
notes: Significance: Grant Road Bridge is one of the earliest bridges located in Rock Creek Park.  Built during the late nineteenth century, the bridge may have been one of the first built with appropriations for the park.
